evidence.title: Bitdeer breaks ground on new energy and digital infrastructure facility in Alberta, Canada
evidence.excerpt: Bitdeer reports breaking ground on a vertically integrated energy and computing facility near Fox Creek, Alberta, pairing an onsite natural-gas plant with a data center.
